content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incorrect, or incomplete. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code verify suggestions, ask precise questions, and implement reviewed changes carefully.
actual_capabilities: Provides a step-by-step pattern for reading, understanding, verifying, evaluating, responding, and implementing review feedback.
Separates guidance for feedback from a human partner and external reviewers.
Prompts agents to ask clarifying questions before partially implementing unclear multi-item reviews.
Encourages checking current codebase usage before adding broad or unused features.
Offers response examples for pushback, corrected assumptions, and GitHub inline review replies.
limitations: Does not inspect code or run tests without the host agent using normal tools.
Does not decide product priorities or architecture without maintainer context.
Does not replace security review for risky code changes.
Uses opinionated communication rules that may not match every team style.

use_cases.title: Triage external review comments
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether outside reviewer suggestions fit the current codebase before accepting them.

use_cases.title: Guide AI-assisted fixes
use_cases.description: Help an AI coding assistant clarify feedback and implement valid changes one item at a time.

use_cases.title: Standardize review responses
use_cases.description: Encourage concise technical replies instead of performative agreement or unsupported pushback.

prompt_templates.title: Restate the feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feedback and restate what needs to change before editing. Ask questions if anything is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate each comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate each review comment against the current codebase. Identify which items are valid, unclear, or need pushback.

prompt_templates.title: Implement verified items
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the valid review feedback one item at a time. After each item, explain the change and test result.

prompt_templates.title: Plan complex pushback
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this complex PR review for conflicts with existing architecture, platform support, and YAGNI. Propose a response plan before changes.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks to remove legacy support, but platform requirements are unclear.
output_examples.output: The skill would verify supported platforms, identify the compatibility risk, and ask whether to fix the legacy path or drop support.

output_examples.input: A review contains six requested fixes, and two are ambiguous.
output_examples.output: The skill would pause implementation, list understood items, and request clarification on the ambiguous items before editing.

output_examples.input: Reviewer suggests adding a broad feature that no current code appears to call.
output_examples.output: The skill would check real usage, note the unused path, and ask whether to remove it or confirm a hidden requirement.

best_practices: Read all feedback before choosing an implementation order.
Verify suggestions against current code, tests, and platform requirements.
Ask focused clarification questions before making partial changes.
anti_patterns: Accepting every reviewer suggestion without checking local context.
Implementing only the clear items while leaving related unclear items unresolved.
Using performative agreement instead of a specific technical response.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically change code?
faq.answer: No. It guides how an agent should evaluate and respond before normal editing tools are used.

faq.question: Can it help with external reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It tells the agent to verify external suggestions against the actual codebase first.

faq.question: Does it encourage rejecting feedback?
faq.answer: No. It encourages technical evaluation, clear questions, and reasoned pushback only when evidence supports it.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide Claude Code workflows for review triage, implementation order, and concise replies.

faq.question: What should happen when feedback is unclear?
faq.answer: The agent should stop, identify the unclear items, and ask for clarification before implementation.

faq.question: Does it replace human maintainers?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure review handling while preserving maintainer authority over architecture and priorities.
